title: Level 5 (World Class) - A-11
notes:
West leads the ♥J against 4♠. The defense cashes the first 2 heart tricks and plays a third round, South ruffing. East is marked with the remainder of the high cards for his 1NT opening. West probably has 4 clubs and 5 hearts for his runout efforts.

If West had a singleton diamond, he probably would have led that card. South has a no-cost safety play available that guards against East holding 4 diamonds to the ♦K and ♦10 along with 3 spades.

South should continue with a diamond to dummy's ♦9. Assume East wins the ♦10 and returns a club. South should win the ♣A and draw 2 rounds of trumps. South crosses in clubs and takes the marked diamond finesse. East will cover and South wins the ♦A. South can now cross in diamonds and cross-ruff the last 3 tricks.
